description: A target that already runs a full unmanaged Vrooli install plus an unrelated non-Vrooli workload. Onboarding, bootstrap and repair must adopt only what the deployment declares and preserve every unrelated process, file and network rule.

participants.workload: existing full install (unmanaged runtime home, own scenarios and resources)
non-Vrooli service listening on its own port with its own firewall rule

shared_dependencies.lifecycle_rule: version reconciled through the approved manifest, never rebuilt from mutable source

journey.invariant: pre-existing and unrelated inventories captured with digests
no process, file or firewall rule outside the subject's ownership changed

journey.action: host repair action through control-plane owner
journey.invariant: typed least-privilege effect only; unrelated rules preserved
post inventory equals pre inventory for pre-existing and unrelated workloads

ownership.cleanup_owner: scenario-to-cloud fixture lease (routed test storage + owned target)
ownership.neighbor_invariant: Unrelated operator data, processes, files and network rules remain unchanged after setup and cleanup (P02-A03).
ownership.write_scope_invariant: Every SQL and file write made while the fixture is leased belongs to its lease scope and its owned target (P02-A02).

lifecycle.note: Setup and teardown argv are returned by the fixture owner at lease time as typed {verb, argv[]} actions; no owner runtime exists at phase 2, so none are recorded here. Never a shell string.
